name: Google AI Quota
author: nonlinearsound
description: Displays your Google AI plan quota, how much you have used, how much is left, AI credits, and reset timers in the Omarchy 4 shell bar.

barWidget.description: Live Google AI & Antigravity plan quota (used vs. remaining), AI credits, and local token activity.

schema.label: Bar display
schema.description: What to show on the bar next to the Google AI sparkle icon.

schema.label: Quota meter style
schema.description: Whether meters fill upward with usage ('used') or drain downward with remaining quota ('remaining').

schema.label: Antigravity CLI path (optional)
schema.description: Leave empty for automatic discovery of `agy`.
